g.text: Each phase is an EG2103 half-bridge driver on a pair of BSC030N08NS5:

g.desc: Each phase is an EG2103 half-bridge driver on a pair of BSC030N08NS5:

g.text: bootstrap diode and capacitor (D101, C105 on phase A), 2R2 gate resistors,

g.desc: bootstrap diode and capacitor (D101, C105 on phase A), 2R2 gate resistors,

g.text: HIN and LIN are held low (R111, R112): with both low the EG2103 turns the

g.desc: HIN and LIN are held low (R111, R112): with both low the EG2103 turns the

g.text: low side on, so a CPU in reset brakes the motor.

g.desc: low side on, so a CPU in reset brakes the motor.

g.text: Inline shunt: two 2m0 in parallel between the switch node and the motor

g.desc: Inline shunt: two 2m0 in parallel between the switch node and the motor

g.text: lead, Kelvin-sensed through 10R, 10R and 1n into an INA241A3. REF1 on +3V3

g.desc: lead, Kelvin-sensed through 10R, 10R and 1n into an INA241A3. REF1 on +3V3

g.text: and REF2 on GND put its output at mid-rail, so it reads current either

g.desc: and REF2 on GND put its output at mid-rail, so it reads current either

g.text: Phase C: the shunts are 0R links and U6, R307, R308, C308 are not fitted.

g.desc: Phase C: the shunts are 0R links and U6, R307, R308, C308 are not fitted.

g.text: The RP2350A has no fourth ADC channel; phase C current is -(Ia + Ib).

g.desc: The RP2350A has no fourth ADC channel; phase C current is -(Ia + Ib).

g.text: R113 + C109 (and B, C): RC snubber across each low side, footprints only.

g.desc: R113 + C109 (and B, C): RC snubber across each low side, footprints only.

g.text: R901: NTC beside the FETs, read on ADC3 as FET_TEMP.

g.desc: R901: NTC beside the FETs, read on ADC3 as FET_TEMP.
